recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew clean assembleFossRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT=app/build/outputs/apk/foss/release/app-foss-release-unsigned.apk
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 16 fix-newlines "$OUT" 'META-INF/services/*'
mv "$OUT" /outputs/unsigned.apk
